sentences.text:
Applicants apprehends arrest in connection with Crime No.249/2020, registered at Police Station-Vijay Nagar, District-Indore (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 406, 201, 34 and 471 of IPC.
4. The prosecution story, in short, is that complainant is a organization known as Nai Duniya which is a venture of Jagran Prakashan Ltd. and came in contact with applicant No.1.

Thereafter,
appointed S & V Associates and its partner namely; Advocate Vibhash Shrungarpure for the renewal of 34 trademark license for Jagran Prakashan Ltd.
Then, complainant inquired about the renewal of trademark license.
He found that office is closed few months back.

Applicant No.1 then also stopped receiving calls of the complainant in this way the applicant No.1 and Advocate Vibhash Shrungarpure fraudulently took the money from the complainant in lieu of the renewal of 34 trademark license.

During investigation statement of Advocate Vibhash Shrungarpure was recorded,
who denied giving the power of attorney to the applicant No.1 and on perusal thereof he stated that the same is forged and fabricated.
On the basis of the aforesaid, the present crime has been registered.
5. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that the applicants are innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is a case of total false implication.
The applicants are ready to co-operate in the investigation.
They are permanent resident of District - Khargone.
There is no likelihood of applicant's absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence if they are released on anticipatory bail.
They are ready to abide by the terms and conditions as may be imposed.
There is no allegation against the applicant No.1 in the present matter as she is not part of the S & V Associates and she never participated in the whole incident.
It is submitted that applicant No.1 has already returned the entire amount to the complainant on 04/04/2023 and the issue has been resolved.
The present applicants belongs to good reputed family and there is no criminal antecedent attributed to them.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of anticipatory bail is made.
6. On the other hand, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application contending even though the money has been returned, there is involvement of both the applicants.
The Advocate Vibhash Shrungarpure in his statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. has stated that he never signed any power of attorney and the same is forged and fabricated.
The applicant No.2 is also involved as the entire transaction took place from a Bank which was being operated from the Mobile Phone of the applicant No.2.

He further submitted that investigation is pending and custodial interrogation may be required, therefore, no case for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicants (Smt. Neha Verma and Ankit Verma) is made out.
7. However, it would not be desirable to enter into merits of the rival contentions at this juncture.
It is well settled that the considerations governing grant of anticipatory bail are altogether different from those relevant for the prayer for regular bail.

8. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, in the opinion of this Court, no case for grant of anticipatory bail of applicants (Smt. Neha Verma and Ankit Verma) is made out.
